---
title: Radishes with Tuna and Pine Nuts
id: MAR-0063
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g of tuna in oil
- 100 g of radish
- 40 g of pine nuts
- 4 slices of country bread
- 2 tablespoons of parsley
- 4 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Toast the pine nuts for a few minutes in a non-stick pan without fat, moving it occasionally by the handle.
2. Wash the radishes, slice them, and put them in a large bowl; season with salt, pepper, and 2 tablespoons of oil, then mix.
3. Divide the bread slices in half and then in half again.
4. Oil the bread and toast it under the oven grill for a few minutes.
5. Meanwhile, drain the tuna, crumble it, and sprinkle it over the radishes.
6. Add the pine nuts, parsley, and serve with the toasted bread.
